title: BOD MEETING
summary: Target: Induct 10 high-quality new members by February 2027. On the agenda was the membership of rotary club of Mumbai Lakers.
description:
Target: Induct 10 high-quality new members by February 2027.
On the agenda was the membership of rotary club of Mumbai Lakers. Afreen suggested that we add at least few members to make it 50 member club, and we are looking at having quality members. Some new rules have been set up wherein anybody wanting to join the Lakers needs to know at least two Lakers and be recommended by them before approaching the club for membership.
